lines: Vishal Chaudhary, an individual selling shareholder, is due proceeds because they sell 1,714,539 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹25.89 crore arrive with listing, scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds will be slightly lower than ₹25.89 crore.
Unknown: average cost of acquisition and retained holding, as shares offered exceed the pre-offer holding; check both tables.
